sources.title: Formula 1 World Championship (1950-2024)
sources.author: Rohan Rao (Vopani)
sources.used_for: Races, results, qualifying, grids, lap times, pit stops and status codes, 1950 to 2024.
sources.notice: Compiled by its author from the Ergast Developer API, which permitted personal and non-commercial use and prohibited charging. Ergast stopped updating after 2024 and its domain now hosts unrelated content, so this page does not link to it.

sources.title: Jolpica F1 API
sources.author: The jolpica-f1 project
sources.used_for: Everything from 2025 onward, in the Ergast schema.
sources.notice: The share-alike and non-commercial terms of this licence apply to Sector 4 as a whole, because the current season's data cannot be separated from the rest.

sources.title: FastF1
sources.author: Philipp Schäfer and contributors
sources.used_for: The library used to retrieve session timing, telemetry, weather and race control data.
sources.notice: Copyright (c) 2026 Philipp Schäfer. MIT covers the library's code, not the data it retrieves. Those terms are separate and stricter — see Formula 1 live timing below.

sources.title: Formula 1 live timing
sources.author: Formula One World Championship Limited
sources.used_for: Model inputs only. None of this data is shown on this site.
sources.notice: Formula 1's legal notices name live timing and historical race data as protected material and prohibit republishing it without prior written consent. It is used locally to fit the model and is never served from here, committed to the repository, or redistributed.
